ruling.recommended_action: Issue a $6.74 voucher to the rider for the unexempted off-route segment (F4); no account flag needed.

segment_findings.reason: Driver proposed the Kranji Expressway detour at 18:37 (F8) and the rider agreed at 18:38 (F9), before the segment started at 18:40; the congestion on the replaced route is corroborated (F11/F12). Exempt under RD-5 (consent before departure from the optimal route).

No route-change request or rider consent covers the 18:59–19:08 segment (driver's own statement: 'the second turn-off was my GPS rerouting', F10); RD-4 does not exempt — no traffic incident on the replaced optimal route (F13) and the speed-band records concern other expressways, so RD-4(b) bands alone cannot exempt (G3). Unexempted off-route segment under RD-1.
